exposure: receipt of doula care prenatally and at delivery
outcome: cesarean delivery of nulliparous, term, singleton, vertex infant
cohort: The cohort consisted of 17,831 deliveries from individuals who received prenatal care at a single institution between January 2021 and December 2022.
finding: Doula care was associated with more vaginal births after cesarean delivery, improved attendance of postpartum office visits, improved breastfeeding rates, and fewer preterm deliveries.
mod_finding: Doula care was associated with more vaginal births after cesarean delivery.
